result.title: VTG-RAG: Long-Video Reasoning via Query-Adaptive Coarse-to-Fine Sampling and Temporal Graph Retrieval
result.summary: Long-video reasoning requires a system to localize sparse evidence over extended temporal sequences, preserve temporal structure, and generate answers despite substantial multimodal distractors. Existing video retrieval-augmented generation methods typically build indexes from uniformly sampled video segments. In long-video settings, this design readily introduces irrelevant context and is unreliable for questions with explicit temporal constraints. We propose VTG-RAG, a framework for long-video question answering that combines query-adaptive coarse-to-fine sampling with temporal graph retrieval. First, a two-stage sampling strategy selects core segments with high mean query relevance or high intra-segment relevance variance. The framework then integrates subtitles, speech transcripts, visual descriptions, entities, and relations from these segments into a temporally ordered multimodal graph. Finally, it performs temporally filtered, two-pass retrieval and reasoning across frame, text, and graph evidence spaces. A lot of experiments have proven the effectiveness of the VTG-RAG. Specifically, we evaluate the framework on Video-MME and LongVideoBench. On LongVideoBench, the reported Qwen2.5-VL-32B and 72B results improve from 48.16% to 50.56% and from 52.13% to 53.32%, respectively, with 24 answer-input frames. These correspond to gains of 2.40 and 1.19 percentage points. The ablation experiments of VTG-RAG further support that the contributions of each component are very important.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 VTG-RAG 长视频问答框架：先用查询相关的两阶段粗到细采样挑选核心片段，再把字幕、语音转写、视觉描述与实体关系组织成时序多模态图，并做带时间过滤的两轮检索推理，在 Video-MME 与 LongVideoBench 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「查询自适应证据筛选＋时间约束过滤」与长视频中视觉证据获取、干扰抑制的关系较直接，可供核查采样与检索策略如何影响证据覆盖；但推理仍是外部检索-生成流程，未涉及 latent 状态或内部视觉信息保留，与 LVR 主线仅有间接联系。
